title: Bit-string simulation of indexed walks
statement: Let $b$ be a natural number, and suppose there is a bijection from the length-$b$ Boolean strings to the $D$ neighbor indices. For any target vertex $t$, any natural number $k$, and any starting vertex $s$, the probability that a uniformly chosen Boolean string of length $kb$, divided into $k$ blocks and decoded into neighbor indices, visits $t$ equals the probability that a uniformly chosen sequence of $k$ neighbor indices visits $t$.
hypotheses_covered: There is a bijection from Boolean strings of length b to the D neighbor indices
